notice: Original game scenario cartography: sourced reconstruction mixed with openly provisional regional/tribal abstractions. Neither exact 278 BCE borders nor copied Rome II/Imperator territories. Original emblems are game symbols, not attested national flags. Unknown land stays neutral. Galatian arrivals have markers only; Bactria and Parthia remain within the Seleucid source extent.

cliopatria.citation: Bennett et al. (2025), Cliopatria, Scientific Data 12:247, DOI 10.1038/s41597-025-04516-9. Dated -278 inclusive subset; selected components/relabeling noted.

dei-factions.role: Reference roster/regional associations only; no copied artwork, game geometry or code.

rome2-factions.role: Official faction families and presentation reference; 272 BCE is not our date.

attalus-278.role: 278 BCE chronology with ancient source references.

oxford-galatia.role: 278 BCE crossing and later territorial settlement; guards against anachronistic fixed Galatia.

imperator-reference.role: Faction granularity/presentation reference; 304 BCE is not copied as 278 BCE.

numidia.role: Numidian regional identities; exact 278 extent remains a scenario abstraction.

iranica-bactria.role: Bactria/Parthia secession is later than this scenario; no independent kingdoms invented.

terrain-border-review.role: Physical terrain and existing GSHHG WDBII river corridors guide bounded provisional-border drawing. Later ancient associations inform only broad placement; no claim of surveyed or confirmed 278 BCE borders.
